title: Alice Goes Down the Rabbit Hole
author: Lewis Carroll
sourceEdition: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865), Project Gutenberg Children's Literature bookshelf

localizedTitles.en: Alice Goes Down the Rabbit Hole
localizedTitles.fr: Alice descend dans le terrier du lapin
localizedTitles.es: Alicia cae en la madriguera del conejo

premise.en: A curious girl follows a clothed white rabbit down a deep hole into a world of locked doors and changing sizes.
premise.fr: Une fille curieuse suit un lapin blanc vêtu dans un trou profond vers un monde de portes verrouillées.
premise.es: Una niña curiosa sigue a un conejo blanco vestido por un agujero profundo hacia un mundo mágico.

summary.en: Alice sits on the riverbank when a White Rabbit with a pocket watch scurries past. She follows him down a rabbit hole into a strange hall. Magic bottles and cakes make her shrink and grow until her own tears fill the room.
summary.fr: Alice est assise au bord de la rivière lorsqu'un Lapin Blanc avec une montre passe en courant. Elle le suit dans un terrier vers une étrange salle. Des potions et gâteaux magiques la font grandir et rétrécir au point de former une mare de larmes.
summary.es: Alicia está sentada junto al río cuando un Conejo Blanco con reloj de bolsillo pasa corriendo. Lo sigue por una madriguera hacia una extraña sala. Frascos y pasteles mágicos la hacen encogerse y crecer hasta llenar la habitación con sus lágrimas.

tutorNotes.pronunciation: Learners should watch the vowel sound in 'climb' and 'curious' as well as the difference between the noun 'tear' (/tɪər/) and the verb 'tear'. Be careful with silent letters in 'half' and 'would', and pronounce the voiced 'th' in 'the', 'this', and 'there' smoothly.
tutorNotes.grammar: This text focuses on present tense narrative forms ('Alice sits', 'she sees', 'she falls') for immediate engagement. Prepositional phrases showing direction and spatial relations ('down the hole', 'into the garden', 'under the table') are practiced frequently.
tutorNotes.culture: Lewis Carroll's Victorian story reflects nineteenth-century English childhood routines, such as afternoon tea and pocket watches. The strange events playfully invert the strict rules and educational lessons expected of Victorian children.
tutorNotes.commonErrors: Beginners frequently confuse the homophones 'to' and 'too', or drop the third-person '-s' on verbs ('she look' instead of 'she looks'). Another common trap is confusing 'fall' with 'feel'.

question.en: What does the White Rabbit take out of his waistcoat pocket?
question.fr: Que sort le Lapin Blanc de la poche de son gilet ?
question.es: ¿Qué saca el Conejo Blanco del bolsillo de su chaleco?

question.en: Why can Alice not go into the lovely garden at first?
question.fr: Pourquoi Alice ne peut-elle pas entrer dans le joli jardin au début ?
question.es: ¿Por qué Alicia no puede entrar en el hermoso jardín al principio?

question.en: What happens when Alice drinks from the little bottle?
question.fr: Que se passe-t-il quand Alice boit à la petite bouteille ?
question.es: ¿Qué sucede cuando Alicia bebe de la pequeña botella?

question.en: Where does Alice find herself swimming at the end?
question.fr: Où Alice se retrouve-t-elle à nager à la fin ?
question.es: ¿Dónde se encuentra nadando Alicia al final?

sentences.text: Alice sits by her sister on the green grass.

translation.en: Alice sits by her sister on the green grass.
translation.fr: Alice est assise près de sa sœur sur l'herbe verte.
translation.es: Alicia está sentada junto a su hermana en la hierba verde.

sentences.text: Her sister reads a book with no pictures.

translation.en: Her sister reads a book with no pictures.
translation.fr: Sa sœur lit un livre sans images.
translation.es: Su hermana lee un libro sin dibujos.

sentences.text: Alice looks at the book.

translation.en: Alice looks at the book.
translation.fr: Alice regarde le livre.
translation.es: Alicia mira el libro.

sentences.text: "What is a book without pictures?" thinks Alice.

translation.en: "What is a book without pictures?" thinks Alice.
translation.fr: « À quoi sert un livre sans images ? » pense Alice.
translation.es: «¿De qué sirve un libro sin dibujos?», piensa Alicia.

sentences.text: Alice feels very warm and very sleepy.

translation.en: Alice feels very warm and very sleepy.
translation.fr: Alice a très chaud et très sommeil.
translation.es: Alicia tiene mucho calor y mucho sueño.

sentences.text: Suddenly, a white rabbit with pink eyes runs past her.

translation.en: Suddenly, a white rabbit with pink eyes runs past her.
translation.fr: Soudain, un lapin blanc aux yeux roses passe en courant devant elle.
translation.es: De repente, un conejo blanco con ojos rosados pasa corriendo junto a ella.

sentences.text: The rabbit is not an ordinary rabbit.

translation.en: The rabbit is not an ordinary rabbit.
translation.fr: Le lapin n'est pas un lapin ordinaire.
translation.es: El conejo no es un conejo común.

sentences.text: It takes a watch out of its waistcoat pocket.

translation.en: It takes a watch out of its waistcoat pocket.
translation.fr: Il sort une montre de la poche de son gilet.
translation.es: Saca un reloj del bolsillo de su chaleco.

sentences.text: The rabbit looks at the watch.

translation.en: The rabbit looks at the watch.
translation.fr: Le lapin regarde la montre.
translation.es: El conejo mira el reloj.

sentences.text: "Oh dear, oh dear!" says the rabbit.

translation.en: "Oh dear, oh dear!" says the rabbit.
translation.fr: « Oh là là, oh là là ! » dit le lapin.
translation.es: «¡Ay, Dios mío!», dice el conejo.

sentences.text: "I shall be late!"

translation.en: "I shall be late!"
translation.fr: « Je vais être en retard ! »
translation.es: «¡Voy a llegar tarde!»

sentences.text: Alice stands up and looks at the rabbit.

translation.en: Alice stands up and looks at the rabbit.
translation.fr: Alice se lève et regarde le lapin.
translation.es: Alicia se pone de pie y mira al conejo.

sentences.text: She never saw a rabbit with a waistcoat before.

translation.en: She never saw a rabbit with a waistcoat before.
translation.fr: Elle n'a jamais vu un lapin avec un gilet auparavant.
translation.es: Nunca antes vio a un conejo con chaleco.

sentences.text: She runs across the green field after it.

translation.en: She runs across the green field after it.
translation.fr: Elle court à travers le pré vert derrière lui.
translation.es: Corre por el campo verde tras él.

sentences.text: The rabbit runs into a large hole under the hedge.

translation.en: The rabbit runs into a large hole under the hedge.
translation.fr: Le lapin entre dans un grand trou sous la haie.
translation.es: El conejo se mete en un gran agujero bajo el seto.

sentences.text: Alice goes into the hole after the rabbit.

translation.en: Alice goes into the hole after the rabbit.
translation.fr: Alice entre dans le trou après le lapin.
translation.es: Alicia entra en el agujero tras el conejo.

sentences.text: She does not think about how she will get out.

translation.en: She does not think about how she will get out.
translation.fr: Elle ne pense pas à la façon dont elle va ressortir.
translation.es: No piensa en cómo saldrá de allí.

sentences.text: The hole goes straight on like a tunnel.

translation.en: The hole goes straight on like a tunnel.
translation.fr: Le trou continue tout droit comme un tunnel.
translation.es: El agujero sigue recto como un túnel.

sentences.text: Then it goes down very suddenly.

translation.en: Then it goes down very suddenly.
translation.fr: Puis il descend très brusquement.
translation.es: Luego desciende muy de repente.

sentences.text: Alice falls down, down, down.

translation.en: Alice falls down, down, down.
translation.fr: Alice tombe, tombe, tombe.
translation.es: Alicia cae y cae y cae.

sentences.text: The well is very deep and dark.

translation.en: The well is very deep and dark.
translation.fr: Le puits est très profond et sombre.
translation.es: El pozo es muy profundo y oscuro.

sentences.text: Alice falls very slowly.

translation.en: Alice falls very slowly.
translation.fr: Alice tombe très lentement.
translation.es: Alicia cae muy despacio.

sentences.text: She has plenty of time to look around.

translation.en: She has plenty of time to look around.
translation.fr: Elle a tout le temps de regarder autour d'elle.
translation.es: Tiene mucho tiempo para mirar a su alrededor.

sentences.text: She sees cupboards and bookshelves on the walls.

translation.en: She sees cupboards and bookshelves on the walls.
translation.fr: Elle voit des placards et des étagères sur les murs.
translation.es: Ve armarios y estanterías en las paredes.

sentences.text: She sees maps and pictures hanging on pegs.

translation.en: She sees maps and pictures hanging on pegs.
translation.fr: Elle voit des cartes et des images accrochées à des patères.
translation.es: Ve mapas y cuadros colgados de clavijas.

sentences.text: Alice takes a jar from one of the shelves.

translation.en: Alice takes a jar from one of the shelves.
translation.fr: Alice prend un pot sur l'une des étagères.
translation.es: Alicia toma un tarro de una de las estanterías.

sentences.text: The jar has a label on it.

translation.en: The jar has a label on it.
translation.fr: Le pot porte une étiquette.
translation.es: El tarro tiene una etiqueta.

sentences.text: The label says ORANGE MARMALADE.

translation.en: The label says ORANGE MARMALADE.
translation.fr: L'étiquette indique MARMELADE D'ORANGE.
translation.es: La etiqueta dice MERMELADA DE NARANJA.

sentences.text: But the jar is empty.

translation.en: But the jar is empty.
translation.fr: Mais le pot est vide.
translation.es: Pero el tarro está vacío.

sentences.text: Alice does not want to drop the jar.

translation.en: Alice does not want to drop the jar.
translation.fr: Alice ne veut pas laisser tomber le pot.
translation.es: Alicia no quiere dejar caer el tarro.

sentences.text: She puts it into another cupboard as she falls past.

translation.en: She puts it into another cupboard as she falls past.
translation.fr: Elle le met dans un autre placard pendant qu'elle tombe.
translation.es: Lo pone en otro armario mientras pasa cayendo.

sentences.text: "Down, down, down," says Alice to herself.

translation.en: "Down, down, down," says Alice to herself.
translation.fr: « Descendre, encore descendre », se dit Alice.
translation.es: «Cae, cae, cae», se dice Alicia a sí misma.

sentences.text: "Will this fall never end?"

translation.en: "Will this fall never end?"
translation.fr: « Cette chute ne finira-t-elle jamais ? »
translation.es: «¿Nunca terminará esta caída?»

sentences.text: "How many miles have I fallen?"

translation.en: "How many miles have I fallen?"
translation.fr: « Combien de kilomètres suis-je tombée ? »
translation.es: «¿Cuántas millas habré caído?»

sentences.text: "I must be near the centre of the earth."

translation.en: "I must be near the centre of the earth."
translation.fr: « Je dois être près du centre de la terre. »
translation.es: «Debo de estar cerca del centro de la tierra.»

sentences.text: She wonders if she will fall through the whole world.

translation.en: She wonders if she will fall through the whole world.
translation.fr: Elle se demande si elle va traverser le monde entier en tombant.
translation.es: Se pregunta si caerá a través de todo el mundo.

sentences.text: "People will walk with their heads down there!"

translation.en: "People will walk with their heads down there!"
translation.fr: « Les gens marcheront la tête en bas là-bas ! »
translation.es: «¡La gente caminará con la cabeza hacia abajo allí!»

sentences.text: Alice begins to think about her cat, Dinah.

translation.en: Alice begins to think about her cat, Dinah.
translation.fr: Alice commence à penser à sa chatte, Dinah.
translation.es: Alicia empieza a pensar en su gata, Dinah.

sentences.text: "Dinah will miss me very much tonight," she says.

translation.en: "Dinah will miss me very much tonight," she says.
translation.fr: « Dinah va beaucoup me manquer ce soir », dit-elle.
translation.es: «Dinah me extrañará mucho esta noche», dice ella.

sentences.text: "I hope they will give her milk at tea time."

translation.en: "I hope they will give her milk at tea time."
translation.fr: « J'espère qu'ils lui donneront du lait à l'heure du thé. »
translation.es: «Espero que le den leche a la hora del té.»

sentences.text: Alice feels very sleepy now.

translation.en: Alice feels very sleepy now.
translation.fr: Alice a très sommeil maintenant.
translation.es: Alicia tiene mucho sueño ahora.

sentences.text: She begins to close her eyes.

translation.en: She begins to close her eyes.
translation.fr: Elle commence à fermer les yeux.
translation.es: Empieza a cerrar los ojos.

sentences.text: Suddenly, thump, thump!

translation.en: Suddenly, thump, thump!
translation.fr: Soudain, boum, boum !
translation.es: De repente, ¡pum, pum!

sentences.text: Alice lands on a heap of dry sticks and leaves.

translation.en: Alice lands on a heap of dry sticks and leaves.
translation.fr: Alice atterrit sur un tas de branches sèches et de feuilles.
translation.es: Alicia aterriza sobre un montón de ramas secas y hojas.

sentences.text: The long fall is over.

translation.en: The long fall is over.
translation.fr: La longue chute est terminée.
translation.es: La larga caída ha terminado.

sentences.text: Alice is not hurt at all.

translation.en: Alice is not hurt at all.
translation.fr: Alice n'est pas blessée du tout.
translation.es: Alicia no está nada herida.

sentences.text: She jumps to her feet and looks up.

translation.en: She jumps to her feet and looks up.
translation.fr: Elle saute sur ses pieds et regarde en l'air.
translation.es: Se pone en pie de un salto y mira hacia arriba.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Hall and the Little Bottle

sentences.text: Alice looks up, but the dark hole is far above her.

translation.en: Alice looks up, but the dark hole is far above her.
translation.fr: Alice regarde en l'air, mais le trou sombre est bien au-dessus d'elle.
translation.es: Alicia mira hacia arriba, pero el agujero oscuro está muy por encima de ella.

sentences.text: Before her is another long corridor.

translation.en: Before her is another long corridor.
translation.fr: Devant elle se trouve un autre long couloir.
translation.es: Frente a ella hay otro largo pasillo.

sentences.text: The White Rabbit is still running down the corridor.

translation.en: The White Rabbit is still running down the corridor.
translation.fr: Le Lapin Blanc court toujours dans le couloir.
translation.es: El Conejo Blanco todavía está corriendo por el pasillo.

sentences.text: He turns a corner very quickly.

translation.en: He turns a corner very quickly.
translation.fr: Il tourne un coin très rapidement.
translation.es: Dobla una esquina muy rápidamente.

sentences.text: "My ears and whiskers, it is late!" he cries.

translation.en: "My ears and whiskers, it is late!" he cries.
translation.fr: « Par mes oreilles et mes moustaches, il est tard ! » crie-t-il.
translation.es: «¡Por mis orejas y bigotes, qué tarde es!», grita.

sentences.text: Alice runs around the corner after him.

translation.en: Alice runs around the corner after him.
translation.fr: Alice court au coin de la rue après lui.
translation.es: Alicia corre doblando la esquina tras él.

sentences.text: But the White Rabbit is not there anymore.

translation.en: But the White Rabbit is not there anymore.
translation.fr: Mais le Lapin Blanc n'est plus là.
translation.es: Pero el Conejo Blanco ya no está allí.

sentences.text: Alice finds herself in a long, low hall.

translation.en: Alice finds herself in a long, low hall.
translation.fr: Alice se retrouve dans une longue salle basse.
translation.es: Alicia se encuentra en una sala larga y baja.

sentences.text: The hall has many lamps hanging from the ceiling.

translation.en: The hall has many lamps hanging from the ceiling.
translation.fr: La salle a de nombreuses lampes suspendues au plafond.
translation.es: La sala tiene muchas lámparas colgando del techo.

sentences.text: There are doors all around the hall.

translation.en: There are doors all around the hall.
translation.fr: Il y a des portes tout autour de la salle.
translation.es: Hay puertas alrededor de toda la sala.

sentences.text: Alice walks to every door, but every door is locked.

translation.en: Alice walks to every door, but every door is locked.
translation.fr: Alice va vers chaque porte, mais chaque porte est verrouillée.
translation.es: Alicia camina hacia cada puerta, pero cada puerta está cerrada con llave.

sentences.text: She cannot open any of them.

translation.en: She cannot open any of them.
translation.fr: Elle ne peut en ouvrir aucune.
translation.es: No puede abrir ninguna de ellas.

sentences.text: She walks sadly down the middle of the hall.

translation.en: She walks sadly down the middle of the hall.
translation.fr: Elle marche tristement au milieu de la salle.
translation.es: Camina tristemente por el centro de la sala.

sentences.text: "How will I ever get out again?" she asks.

translation.en: "How will I ever get out again?" she asks.
translation.fr: « Comment pourrai-je jamais ressortir ? » demande-t-elle.
translation.es: «¿Cómo podré salir de nuevo?», se pregunta.

sentences.text: Suddenly, she sees a little table with three legs.

translation.en: Suddenly, she sees a little table with three legs.
translation.fr: Soudain, elle voit une petite table à trois pieds.
translation.es: De repente, ve una mesita de tres patas.

sentences.text: The little table is made of solid glass.

translation.en: The little table is made of solid glass.
translation.fr: La petite table est en verre massif.
translation.es: La mesita está hecha de vidrio macizo.

sentences.text: On the table is a tiny golden key.

translation.en: On the table is a tiny golden key.
translation.fr: Sur la table se trouve une minuscule clé dorée.
translation.es: Sobre la mesa hay una diminuta llave dorada.

sentences.text: Alice picks up the golden key.

translation.en: Alice picks up the golden key.
translation.fr: Alice ramasse la clé dorée.
translation.es: Alicia toma la llave dorada.

sentences.text: She tries to open the doors of the hall with it.

translation.en: She tries to open the doors of the hall with it.
translation.fr: Elle essaie d'ouvrir les portes de la salle avec.
translation.es: Intenta abrir las puertas de la sala con ella.

sentences.text: But the key is too small, or the locks are too large.

translation.en: But the key is too small, or the locks are too large.
translation.fr: Mais la clé est trop petite, ou les serrures sont trop grandes.
translation.es: Pero la llave es demasiado pequeña, o las cerraduras son demasiado grandes.

sentences.text: Not one door will open.

translation.en: Not one door will open.
translation.fr: Pas une seule porte ne veut s'ouvrir.
translation.es: Ni una sola puerta se abre.

sentences.text: Then Alice sees a low curtain near the floor.

translation.en: Then Alice sees a low curtain near the floor.
translation.fr: Puis Alice voit un rideau bas près du sol.
translation.es: Entonces Alicia ve una cortina baja cerca del suelo.

sentences.text: Behind the curtain is a little door.

translation.en: Behind the curtain is a little door.
translation.fr: Derrière le rideau se trouve une petite porte.
translation.es: Detrás de la cortina hay una puertecita.

sentences.text: The door is only fifteen inches high.

translation.en: The door is only fifteen inches high.
translation.fr: La porte ne mesure que quinze pouces de haut.
translation.es: La puerta mide solo quince pulgadas de alto.

sentences.text: Alice puts the golden key into the lock.

translation.en: Alice puts the golden key into the lock.
translation.fr: Alice met la clé dorée dans la serrure.
translation.es: Alicia pone la llave dorada en la cerradura.

sentences.text: To her great delight, the key fits!

translation.en: To her great delight, the key fits!
translation.fr: À sa grande joie, la clé convient !
translation.es: ¡Para su gran alegría, la llave encaja!

sentences.text: Alice opens the door and looks through it.

translation.en: Alice opens the door and looks through it.
translation.fr: Alice ouvre la porte et regarde à travers.
translation.es: Alicia abre la puerta y mira a través de ella.

sentences.text: She kneels down on the floor.

translation.en: She kneels down on the floor.
translation.fr: Elle s'agenouille sur le sol.
translation.es: Se arrodilla en el suelo.

sentences.text: She sees the loveliest garden you ever saw.

translation.en: She sees the loveliest garden you ever saw.
translation.fr: Elle voit le plus beau jardin que vous ayez jamais vu.
translation.es: Ve el jardín más hermoso que jamás hayas visto.

sentences.text: The garden is full of bright flowers and cool fountains.

translation.en: The garden is full of bright flowers and cool fountains.
translation.fr: Le jardin est plein de fleurs éclatantes et de fontaines fraîches.
translation.es: El jardín está lleno de flores brillantes y fuentes frescas.

sentences.text: Alice wants to walk among those beautiful flowers.

translation.en: Alice wants to walk among those beautiful flowers.
translation.fr: Alice veut marcher parmi ces belles fleurs.
translation.es: Alicia quiere caminar entre esas hermosas flores.

sentences.text: But she cannot even get her head through the doorway.

translation.en: But she cannot even get her head through the doorway.
translation.fr: Mais elle ne peut même pas passer la tête par la porte.
translation.es: Pero ni siquiera puede pasar la cabeza por el umbral.

sentences.text: "I wish I could shut up like a telescope," says Alice.

translation.en: "I wish I could shut up like a telescope," says Alice.
translation.fr: « J'aimerais pouvoir me replier comme un télescope », dit Alice.
translation.es: «Ojalá pudiera cerrarme como un telescopio», dice Alicia.

sentences.text: She shuts the little door and goes back to the glass table.

translation.en: She shuts the little door and goes back to the glass table.
translation.fr: Elle ferme la petite porte et retourne à la table de verre.
translation.es: Cierra la puertecita y vuelve a la mesa de vidrio.

sentences.text: She hopes to find another key upon it.

translation.en: She hopes to find another key upon it.
translation.fr: Elle espère y trouver une autre clé.
translation.es: Espera encontrar otra llave sobre ella.

sentences.text: There is no key, but she finds a little bottle.

translation.en: There is no key, but she finds a little bottle.
translation.fr: Il n'y a pas de clé, mais elle trouve une petite bouteille.
translation.es: No hay ninguna llave, pero encuentra una botellita.

sentences.text: "I am sure this was not here before," says Alice.

translation.en: "I am sure this was not here before," says Alice.
translation.fr: « Je suis sûre que cela n'était pas là avant », dit Alice.
translation.es: «Estoy segura de que esto no estaba aquí antes», dice Alicia.

sentences.text: Around the neck of the bottle is a paper label.

translation.en: Around the neck of the bottle is a paper label.
translation.fr: Autour du goulot de la bouteille se trouve une étiquette en papier.
translation.es: Alrededor del cuello de la botella hay una etiqueta de papel.

sentences.text: The words DRINK ME are printed on the label.

translation.en: The words DRINK ME are printed on the label.
translation.fr: Les mots BOIS-MOI sont imprimés sur l'étiquette.
translation.es: Las palabras BÉBEME están impresas en la etiqueta.

sentences.text: Alice is a wise girl, so she does not drink it at once.

translation.en: Alice is a wise girl, so she does not drink it at once.
translation.fr: Alice est une fille sage, elle ne la boit donc pas tout de suite.
translation.es: Alicia es una niña prudente, así que no la bebe de golpe.

sentences.text: "First, I will look to see if it says poison," she says.

translation.en: "First, I will look to see if it says poison," she says.
translation.fr: « D'abord, je vais regarder si elle porte la mention poison », dit-elle.
translation.es: «Primero miraré a ver si dice veneno», dice ella.

sentences.text: The bottle does not say poison.

translation.en: The bottle does not say poison.
translation.fr: La bouteille n'indique pas poison.
translation.es: La botella no dice veneno.

sentences.text: So Alice tastes a little drop of the drink.

translation.en: So Alice tastes a little drop of the drink.
translation.fr: Alors Alice goûte une petite goutte de la boisson.
translation.es: Así que Alicia prueba una pequeña gota de la bebida.

sentences.text: It tastes very nice, like cherry tart and hot butter toast.

translation.en: It tastes very nice, like cherry tart and hot butter toast.
translation.fr: Elle a très bon goût, comme une tarte aux cerises et du pain grillé au beurre chaud.
translation.es: Sabe muy rica, como tarta de cerezas y tostada caliente con mantequilla.

sentences.text: She drinks the whole bottle very quickly.

translation.en: She drinks the whole bottle very quickly.
translation.fr: Elle boit toute la bouteille très rapidement.
translation.es: Se bebe toda la botella muy rápidamente.

sentences.text: "What a curious feeling!" cries Alice.

translation.en: "What a curious feeling!" cries Alice.
translation.fr: « Quelle curieuse sensation ! » s'écrie Alice.
translation.es: «¡Qué sensación tan curiosa!», grita Alicia.

sentences.text: "I am shutting up like a telescope!"

translation.en: "I am shutting up like a telescope!"
translation.fr: « Je me replie comme un télescope ! »
translation.es: «¡Me estoy cerrando como un telescopio!»

sentences.text: Alice is now only ten inches high.

translation.en: Alice is now only ten inches high.
translation.fr: Alice ne mesure plus que dix pouces de haut.
translation.es: Alicia mide ahora solo diez pulgadas de altura.

sentences.text: Her face shines with joy.

translation.en: Her face shines with joy.
translation.fr: Son visage rayonne de joie.
translation.es: Su rostro brilla de alegría.

sentences.text: She can go into the lovely garden now!

translation.en: She can go into the lovely garden now!
translation.fr: Elle peut aller dans le joli jardin maintenant !
translation.es: ¡Ahora puede entrar al hermoso jardín!

sentences.text: But when she reaches the door, she remembers the golden key.

translation.en: But when she reaches the door, she remembers the golden key.
translation.fr: Mais quand elle arrive à la porte, elle se souvient de la clé dorée.
translation.es: Pero cuando llega a la puerta, recuerda la llave dorada.

sentences.text: She left the key on the glass table.

translation.en: She left the key on the glass table.
translation.fr: Elle a laissé la clé sur la table de verre.
translation.es: Dejó la llave sobre la mesa de vidrio.

sentences.text: She goes back to the table, but she cannot reach the top.

translation.en: She goes back to the table, but she cannot reach the top.
translation.fr: Elle retourne à la table, mais elle ne peut pas atteindre le dessus.
translation.es: Vuelve a la mesa, pero no puede alcanzar la superficie.

sentences.text: The glass legs are very smooth and slippery.

translation.en: The glass legs are very smooth and slippery.
translation.fr: Les pieds de verre sont très lisses et glissants.
translation.es: Las patas de vidrio son muy lisas y resbaladizas.

sentences.text: Poor Alice sits down on the floor and cries.

translation.en: Poor Alice sits down on the floor and cries.
translation.fr: La pauvre Alice s'assoit par terre et pleure.
translation.es: La pobre Alicia se sienta en el suelo y llora.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Little Cake and the Pool of Tears

sentences.text: "Come, there is no use in crying like that!" says Alice to herself.

translation.en: "Come, there is no use in crying like that!" says Alice to herself.
translation.fr: « Allons, il ne sert à rien de pleurer comme ça ! » se dit Alice.
translation.es: «¡Vamos, de nada sirve llorar así!», se dice Alicia a sí misma.

sentences.text: She tells herself to stop crying at once.

translation.en: She tells herself to stop crying at once.
translation.fr: Elle se dit d'arrêter de pleurer immédiatement.
translation.es: Se dice a sí misma que deje de llorar de inmediato.

sentences.text: She usually gives herself very good advice.

translation.en: She usually gives herself very good advice.
translation.fr: Elle se donne d'habitude de très bons conseils.
translation.es: Por lo general, se da a sí misma muy buenos consejos.

sentences.text: Soon her eye falls upon a little glass box under the table.

translation.en: Soon her eye falls upon a little glass box under the table.
translation.fr: Bientôt son regard tombe sur une petite boîte en verre sous la table.
translation.es: Pronto sus ojos ven una cajita de cristal debajo de la mesa.

sentences.text: She opens the box and finds a very small cake inside.

translation.en: She opens the box and finds a very small cake inside.
translation.fr: Elle ouvre la boîte et trouve un très petit gâteau à l'intérieur.
translation.es: Abre la caja y encuentra un pastelito muy pequeño dentro.

sentences.text: The words EAT ME are written on the cake with currants.

translation.en: The words EAT ME are written on the cake with currants.
translation.fr: Les mots MANGE-MOI sont écrits sur le gâteau avec des raisins secs.
translation.es: Las palabras CÓMEME están escritas en el pastel con pasas.

sentences.text: "Well, I will eat it," says Alice.

translation.en: "Well, I will eat it," says Alice.
translation.fr: « Eh bien, je vais le manger », dit Alice.
translation.es: «Bueno, me lo comeré», dice Alicia.

sentences.text: "If it makes me larger, I can reach the key."

translation.en: "If it makes me larger, I can reach the key."
translation.fr: « S'il me fait grandir, je pourrai atteindre la clé. »
translation.es: «Si me hace más grande, podré alcanzar la llave.»

sentences.text: "If it makes me smaller, I can creep under the door."

translation.en: "If it makes me smaller, I can creep under the door."
translation.fr: « S'il me fait rapetisser, je pourrai me glisser sous la porte. »
translation.es: «Si me hace más pequeña, podré deslizarme bajo la puerta.»

sentences.text: Alice eats a small bite of the cake.

translation.en: Alice eats a small bite of the cake.
translation.fr: Alice mange une petite bouchée du gâteau.
translation.es: Alicia come un pequeño bocado del pastel.

sentences.text: She holds her hand upon her head.

translation.en: She holds her hand upon her head.
translation.fr: Elle pose sa main sur sa tête.
translation.es: Pone su mano sobre su cabeza.

sentences.text: "Which way? Which way?" she asks anxiously.

translation.en: "Which way? Which way?" she asks anxiously.
translation.fr: « Dans quel sens ? Dans quel sens ? » demande-t-elle avec anxiété.
translation.es: «¿Hacia dónde? ¿Hacia dónde?», pregunta con ansiedad.

sentences.text: At first, nothing happens.

translation.en: At first, nothing happens.
translation.fr: Au début, rien ne se passe.
translation.es: Al principio no sucede nada.

sentences.text: But then she begins to grow very quickly.

translation.en: But then she begins to grow very quickly.
translation.fr: Mais ensuite elle commence à grandir très vite.
translation.es: Pero entonces empieza a crecer muy rápido.

sentences.text: "Curiouser and curiouser!" cries Alice.

translation.en: "Curiouser and curiouser!" cries Alice.
translation.fr: « De plus en plus curieux ! » s'écrie Alice.
translation.es: «¡Cada vez más curioso!», grita Alicia.

sentences.text: "Now I am opening out like the largest telescope!"

translation.en: "Now I am opening out like the largest telescope!"
translation.fr: « Maintenant je m'étire comme le plus grand des télescopes ! »
translation.es: «¡Ahora me abro como el telescopio más grande!»

sentences.text: Her head hits against the high ceiling of the hall.

translation.en: Her head hits against the high ceiling of the hall.
translation.fr: Sa tête heurte le haut plafond de la salle.
translation.es: Su cabeza choca contra el alto techo de la sala.

sentences.text: In fact, Alice is now more than nine feet tall.

translation.en: In fact, Alice is now more than nine feet tall.
translation.fr: En fait, Alice mesure maintenant plus de neuf pieds de haut.
translation.es: De hecho, Alicia mide ahora más de nueve pies de altura.

sentences.text: She picks up the golden key from the table.

translation.en: She picks up the golden key from the table.
translation.fr: Elle ramasse la clé dorée sur la table.
translation.es: Recoge la llave dorada de la mesa.

sentences.text: Then she hurries to the garden door.

translation.en: Then she hurries to the garden door.
translation.fr: Puis elle se dépêche d'aller à la porte du jardin.
translation.es: Luego se apresura hacia la puerta del jardín.

sentences.text: But poor Alice can only lie down and look through with one eye.

translation.en: But poor Alice can only lie down and look through with one eye.
translation.fr: Mais la pauvre Alice ne peut que s'allonger et regarder d'un seul œil.
translation.es: Pero la pobre Alicia solo puede acostarse y mirar con un ojo.

sentences.text: To go into the garden is more hopeless than ever.

translation.en: To go into the garden is more hopeless than ever.
translation.fr: Aller dans le jardin est plus désespéré que jamais.
translation.es: Entrar al jardín es más imposible que nunca.

sentences.text: She sits down again and begins to cry.

translation.en: She sits down again and begins to cry.
translation.fr: Elle se rassied et commence à pleurer.
translation.es: Se sienta de nuevo y empieza a llorar.

sentences.text: She sheds gallons of tears.

translation.en: She sheds gallons of tears.
translation.fr: Elle verse des litres de larmes.
translation.es: Derrama galones de lágrimas.

sentences.text: Her large tears form a deep pool around her.

translation.en: Her large tears form a deep pool around her.
translation.fr: Ses grosses larmes forment une mare profonde autour d'elle.
translation.es: Sus grandes lágrimas forman un profundo charco a su alrededor.

sentences.text: The pool of tears covers half the hall floor.

translation.en: The pool of tears covers half the hall floor.
translation.fr: La mare de larmes couvre la moitié du sol de la salle.
translation.es: El charco de lágrimas cubre la mitad del suelo de la sala.

sentences.text: After some time, she hears little footsteps in the distance.

translation.en: After some time, she hears little footsteps in the distance.
translation.fr: Après un certain temps, elle entend de petits pas au loin.
translation.es: Después de un tiempo, oye pequeños pasos en la distancia.

sentences.text: It is the White Rabbit returning.

translation.en: It is the White Rabbit returning.
translation.fr: C'est le Lapin Blanc qui revient.
translation.es: Es el Conejo Blanco que regresa.

sentences.text: He is splendidly dressed, with white kid gloves and a little fan.

translation.en: He is splendidly dressed, with white kid gloves and a little fan.
translation.fr: Il est magnifiquement habillé, avec des gants de chevreau blancs et un petit éventail.
translation.es: Está espléndidamente vestido, con guantes blancos de cabritilla y un pequeño abanico.

sentences.text: "Oh, the Duchess, the Duchess!" he mutters to himself.

translation.en: "Oh, the Duchess, the Duchess!" he mutters to himself.
translation.fr: « Oh, la Duchesse, la Duchesse ! » marmonne-t-il pour lui-même.
translation.es: «¡Oh, la Duquesa, la Duquesa!», murmura para sí mismo.

sentences.text: "She will be angry if I have kept her waiting!"

translation.en: "She will be angry if I have kept her waiting!"
translation.fr: « Elle sera en colère si je l'ai fait attendre ! »
translation.es: «¡Se enfadará si la he hecho esperar!»

sentences.text: Alice feels desperate and calls out to him.

translation.en: Alice feels desperate and calls out to him.
translation.fr: Alice se sent désespérée et l'appelle.
translation.es: Alicia se siente desesperada y lo llama.

sentences.text: "If you please, sir—" she says in a soft voice.

translation.en: "If you please, sir—" she says in a soft voice.
translation.fr: « S'il vous plaît, monsieur... » dit-elle d'une voix douce.
translation.es: «Por favor, señor...», dice con voz suave.

sentences.text: The Rabbit is terrified by the giant voice.

translation.en: The Rabbit is terrified by the giant voice.
translation.fr: Le Lapin est terrifié par cette voix géante.
translation.es: El Conejo está aterrorizado por la voz gigante.

sentences.text: He drops his white gloves and fan, and runs away into the darkness.

translation.en: He drops his white gloves and fan, and runs away into the darkness.
translation.fr: Il laisse tomber ses gants blancs et son éventail, et s'enfuit dans l'obscurité.
translation.es: Deja caer sus guantes blancos y su abanico, y huye hacia la oscuridad.

sentences.text: Alice picks up the fan and the gloves.

translation.en: Alice picks up the fan and the gloves.
translation.fr: Alice ramasse l'éventail et les gants.
translation.es: Alicia recoge el abanico y los guantes.

sentences.text: The hall is very hot, so she fans herself.

translation.en: The hall is very hot, so she fans herself.
translation.fr: La salle est très chaude, alors elle s'évente.
translation.es: Hace mucho calor en la sala, así que se abanica.

sentences.text: "Dear me, how strange everything is today!" she says.

translation.en: "Dear me, how strange everything is today!" she says.
translation.fr: « Mon Dieu, comme tout est étrange aujourd'hui ! » dit-elle.
translation.es: «¡Dios mío, qué extraño es todo hoy!», dice ella.

sentences.text: As she fans herself, she looks down at her hands.

translation.en: As she fans herself, she looks down at her hands.
translation.fr: Tandis qu'elle s'évente, elle regarde ses mains.
translation.es: Mientras se abanica, mira hacia abajo a sus manos.

sentences.text: She sees that she is shrinking again.

translation.en: She sees that she is shrinking again.
translation.fr: Elle s'aperçoit qu'elle rétrécit à nouveau.
translation.es: Ve que se está encogiendo de nuevo.

sentences.text: She drops the fan quickly, just before shrinking away altogether.

translation.en: She drops the fan quickly, just before shrinking away altogether.
translation.fr: Elle lâche l'éventail rapidement, juste avant de disparaître complètement.
translation.es: Suelta el abanico rápidamente, justo antes de encogerse por completo.

sentences.text: Now she is only two feet tall and still getting smaller.

translation.en: Now she is only two feet tall and still getting smaller.
translation.fr: Maintenant elle ne mesure que deux pieds et continue de rapetisser.
translation.es: Ahora solo mide dos pies y sigue haciéndose más pequeña.

sentences.text: Suddenly, her foot slips upon the smooth stones.

translation.en: Suddenly, her foot slips upon the smooth stones.
translation.fr: Soudain, son pied glisse sur les pierres lisses.
translation.es: De repente, su pie resbala sobre las piedras lisas.

sentences.text: Splash! She falls into salt water up to her chin.

translation.en: Splash! She falls into salt water up to her chin.
translation.fr: Plouf ! Elle tombe dans de l'eau salée jusqu'au menton.
translation.es: ¡Chof! Cae en agua salada hasta la barbilla.

sentences.text: At first she thinks she has fallen into the sea.

translation.en: At first she thinks she has fallen into the sea.
translation.fr: Au début elle pense être tombée dans la mer.
translation.es: Al principio piensa que ha caído al mar.

sentences.text: But soon she knows the truth.

translation.en: But soon she knows the truth.
translation.fr: Mais bientôt elle comprend la vérité.
translation.es: Pero pronto descubre la verdad.

sentences.text: She is swimming in her own pool of tears.

translation.en: She is swimming in her own pool of tears.
translation.fr: Elle nage dans sa propre mare de larmes.
translation.es: Está nadando en su propio charco de lágrimas.

sentences.text: "I wish I had not cried so much!" says Alice.

translation.en: "I wish I had not cried so much!" says Alice.
translation.fr: « J'aimerais ne pas avoir tant pleuré ! » dit Alice.
translation.es: «¡Ojalá no hubiera llorado tanto!», dice Alicia.

sentences.text: Just then, she hears something splashing in the pool near her.

translation.en: Just then, she hears something splashing in the pool near her.
translation.fr: Juste à ce moment, elle entend quelque chose qui barbote dans la mare près d'elle.
translation.es: En ese momento, oye algo chapotear en el charco cerca de ella.

sentences.text: Many birds and animals have fallen into the water as well.

translation.en: Many birds and animals have fallen into the water as well.
translation.fr: Beaucoup d'oiseaux et d'animaux sont tombés dans l'eau également.
translation.es: Muchos pájaros y animales también han caído al agua.

sentences.text: There is a mouse, a duck, a dodo, and an owlet.

translation.en: There is a mouse, a duck, a dodo, and an owlet.
translation.fr: Il y a une souris, un canard, un dodo et un chouetton.
translation.es: Hay un ratón, un pato, un dodo y un mochuelo.

sentences.text: Alice swims beside them towards the edge.

translation.en: Alice swims beside them towards the edge.
translation.fr: Alice nage à côté d'eux vers le bord.
translation.es: Alicia nada junto a ellos hacia la orilla.

sentences.text: Soon the whole strange party swims safely to the bank.

translation.en: Soon the whole strange party swims safely to the bank.
translation.fr: Bientôt toute l'étrange troupe nage en sécurité jusqu'à la rive.
translation.es: Pronto todo el extraño grupo nada a salvo hasta la orilla.
